<!-- pr-reviewer: da5862cd3dc77545eae19fa7a71a5aae0cb4f751 -->

Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- The PR changes test files only. No file under `src/` changed.
- Each loop case is now its own test. The module keeps the old test name, so a filter on the old name still selects the cases. I checked this.
- The coverage stays the same. I diffed the sorted assert and expect lines, before against after: the diff is empty. keep_law has 44 such lines. level_links has 52.
- No test gained or lost `#[ignore]`. Every file is under 400 lines.
- The commit subject follows the conventional-commit format. The commit body ends `Refs #1715`. This PR is partial work for that issue, so `Refs` is the right choice.
- The PR body is complete: what changed, timings, what was not exercised, `Changelog: none`.

## Results

I built and tested locally, in my own worktree at this head, merged with current `main` (7c514c874). The trial merge was clean. No conflict.

- keep_law: 31 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored. 67.9 s in debug.
- level_links: 25 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored. 35.6 s in debug.
- Filter run: the name `a_whole_model_area_offset_into_the_part_gouges_and_never_posts` selected 4 cases. All passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test keep_law --test level_links -- -D warnings`: clean.

`main` changed `crates/app/src/operation/keep_law.rs` since this branch opened. The suites pass on the merged tree, so the split holds against that change too.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes

- The MCP cases now run in parallel. Each case writes its own temp dir, named by its tag, so the names do not collide.
- The timings in the body match my runs.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 8072cce76ebdb38ab6fd7a9f4dc01f375b723bc2 -->

**Verdict: Ready for merge (delta review of the conflict resolution).**

A collaborator review with a clean verdict covers head da5862cd3. The head
moved only by a merge of main. That merge has one hand-resolved conflict.
This review covers only that delta.

**Delta check**

- `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 1838 --reviewed da5862cd3` classes the
  delta as DELTA: `8072cce7 merge of main, HAND-RESOLVED:
  crates/app/tests/level_links.rs`.
- The remerge-diff touches no other file. The diff against main lists only
  the five test files of this PR.
- The hand resolution keeps both sides. Main's `to_tri` helper and the
  #1774 footprint-distance assertion now sit in this PR's shared case
  helper `never_under_the_bore_floor`. Main's loop test became four cases:
  helix, plunge, ramp and arc. Each case calls the helper.
- No test from main is dropped. All seven test names from main are present,
  split across the case modules and `level_links/choices.rs`.
- No function name repeats in one scope. This PR's case split and its
  golden asserts are intact.

**Build and tests (local, in the review worktree, debug tier)**

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test level_links` | pass: 25 tests, 0 failed, 0 ignored (35.8 s) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test keep_law` | pass: 31 tests, 0 failed, 0 ignored (62.7 s) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | pass: clean |

The four bore-floor cases pass with main's stronger assertion. That proves
the merged logic holds in the new case structure. The review found no
blockers.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
